compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: When dso:task-decomposer is invoked with a remediation_context, its output begins with a DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration (token sourced from the shared-protocol doc) and contains an evidence quote from each reviewer-artifact path before any task draft.
- dd-3: Delta-mode task-decomposer output preserves prior tasks and AC items that are not named in any finding (no silent drop of unrelated prior work) and preserves the existing TDD task structure (RED-before-GREEN, depends_on chain) for modified entries.
- dd-4: When either agent is invoked without a remediation_context, output shape is unchanged from current behavior.

## Description

Edit plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md to add two additions, in this order:

1. **Inputs section addition** — under the existing `## Inputs` section (after the existing input subsections), add an optional subsection:

   `### Remediation Context (optional)`

   Declares `remediation_context` as an OPTIONAL input with sub-fields:
   - `reviewer_artifact_paths` (array of absolute paths) — reviewer artifacts that drive this delta cycle
   - `findings` (array) — structured findings each carrying at minimum a `target` (temp_id or existing task id, or n/a) and a `description`
   - `target_story_id` (string) — the story this delta cycle is scoped to

   State explicitly: when `remediation_context` is absent, the agent follows the existing protocol unchanged.

2. **DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub** — add a new top-level section titled exactly `=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===`. The stub MUST include:

   a. Reference to the DELTA OUTPUT template in the shared protocol doc.

   b. Three non-delegatable runtime rules restated inline:
      - **Pre-generation Read gate**: the agent MUST Read each absolute path in `reviewer_artifact_paths` BEFORE drafting any task. The output MUST begin with `EVIDENCE FROM <path>:` blocks (one per reviewer-artifact path) containing a verbatim quote from each artifact.
      - **Preserve-by-omission**: tasks not named in any finding MUST be omitted from delta output entirely; only tasks explicitly named in `findings` appear in delta output with modifications.
      - **TDD-schema preservation**: for tasks being modified, the agent MUST preserve `RED-before-GREEN` task ordering, the `depends_on` chain (no orphan edges), and the `testing_mode` field (RED/GREEN/UPDATE).

   c. A pointer to the per-agent schema-preservation sub-section in the protocol doc (`### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer`).

The RED test (task cd88-7ef3-230e-40cc) must transition to GREEN when this task lands. Also re-run the approach-proposer RED test (d071-852d-27e6-4a86) as a cross-agent dd-4 sanity check.

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria

- Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- RED test now passes (GREEN transition) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-remediation.sh
- Approach-proposer RED test still passes (cross-agent backward-compat sanity for dd-4) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-approach-proposer-remediation.sh
- Agent file contains the literal DELTA OUTPUT MODE token — Verify: grep -qF '=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- Inputs section contains the optional Remediation Context subsection — Verify: grep -qE '^### Remediation Context \(optional\)' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub includes EVIDENCE FROM format and pre-generation Read gate — Verify: awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qE 'EVIDENCE FROM' && awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qEi 'Read each absolute|pre-generation Read'
- DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub includes all three TDD-preservation invariants — Verify: awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qE 'RED-before-GREEN' && awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qE 'depends_on' && awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qE 'testing.mode'
- DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub references protocol doc and task-decomposer sub-section — Verify: awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qE 'remediation-loop-protocol.md' && awk '/=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===/,/^## |^=== /' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qE 'Schema Preservation — task-decomposer'
- Agent model directive remains opus — Verify: grep -qE '^model:[[:space:]]*opus' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- Pre-existing output schema still documented — Verify: grep -qE '"task_drafts"' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qE '"dd_partition_map"' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
